ALLEGRA BOVERMAN/Staff photo. Gloucester Daily Times. Essex: Two male goats were born about 1:15 p.m. on Thursday at Apple Street Farm. Their mother, Peekaboo,  who gave birth for the first time on Thursday, is an Alpine and their father is a Nubian goat from a farm in Topsfield. One baby goat has Nubian ears, the other Alpine ears. The two boys will join four other baby goats born in the last month at the farm.
